notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030738/f96a070ffa571f993d7ca3a0124e9a926dc7655f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone! This is the changelog of the update that [i]was a week ago[/i]![/p][p]But first I want to say that you can play the demo as much as you want, as the save files can be transferred to the main game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's new:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b][u]At the request of many players now during the attack and dash you can jump at any time![/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixes some places where you can get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]It is now impossible to attack in a jump immediately after jumping (buffer 0,15s)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix navigation in pause menu with gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Fix water circles in some bodies of water[/p][/*][*][p]Now borderless mode automatically sets the screen resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Fix double jumping on the rail[/p][/*][*][p]Fix character behavior on rails for different amount of fps[/p][/*][*][p]Player behavior on rails is now more responsive[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the jump buffer after a normal hit[/p][/*][*][p]Made new collisions of wall and floor models[/p][/*][*][p]Boar now doesn't deal damage if the player attacks it up close[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed no vision activation if you skip a cutscene after a boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not removing eye effect from boss during its death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed no corpse after boss death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grass appearing on some slopes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to Landscape material[/p][/*][*][p]Added more floor and wall textures for visual variety[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What's coming next:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Level 0 (Can be playable even on current save)[/p][/*][*][p]Store[/p][/*][*][p]Pets[/p][/*][*][p]More secrets at level 1[/p][/*][*][p]More hats[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades for the hub location[/p][/*][*][p]Map[/p][/*][*][p]Different hints during the game[/p][/*][*][p]Different UX and UI improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.5
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed wrong player spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Better gamepad camera controls[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030738/10b0c64fc2919a4f0d6aaaae1c73555e8c4eba43.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Combo attacks reworked: the first two hits now have reduced knockback, while the third hit knocks enemies further away.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump attack knockback significantly increased (now surpasses the third combo hit).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased knockback from boss attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Revised rail grinding mechanics: jumping off rails is now more forgiving.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a brief input delay after falling into a void to prevent players from immediately falling again.[/p][/*][*][p]Teleporting now requires standing in a portal for several seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jump buffer when the player starts falling off a platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jump buffer when the player is about to land on a platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to skip cutscenes.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Levels:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted collision on certain objects to reduce instances of the player getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked level design in some areas of the first location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the landscape geometry under the river.[/p][/*][*][p]Added one-way drops and visual landmarks in specific areas to reduce player confusion during initial playthroughs.[/p][/*][*][p]Relocated some secrets (Save files will remain compatible).[/p][/*][*][p]Added slime texture to slippery sections.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Visuals:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player hats are now hidden when the camera gets too close.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed environmental rendering issues on older systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a damage animation to the boss's health icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a damage animation to the boss's health bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added different boss icons for different health states.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a health bar animation when the boss transitions to its next phase.[/p][/*][*][p]The boss's health bar now visually changes between phases.[/p][/*][*][p]Added subtle physics to the main character's hair.[/p][/*][*][p]Active checkpoints are now visually distinct (different color) from inactive ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a menacing glow to the boss's eyes during its second phase.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ambient air particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the portal visual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a background to the customization menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added color indicators to moving platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects for moving platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]The health bar is now hidden during cutscenes and when the player dies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Optimization:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Further optimizations and performance improvements for GPUs.[/p][/*][*][p]UI performance optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Miscellaneous:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the character's lean animation when running into obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies can no longer control their direction while falling.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the animation of the scared tree when the player is nearby to make its fear more apparent.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a text notification about teleporting to another location via portals.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an impact sound when hitting shortcuts from the wrong side.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification when a shortcut is opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification when a shortcut is blocked from the other side.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the text notification displayed when finding customization items.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing acceleration while grinding on rails.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing jumping while grinding on rails.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the boss would follow the player but not attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the boss fight to reset during the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where minions could attack the player during the boss's phase transition.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cutscene animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the post-boss cutscene where player customization failed to display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display of the boss's spear model and effects during its dash attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the boss's transition animation to the second phase if it occurred during his spin attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved character color rendering in the customization menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where slide mode wouldn't deactivate properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the single jump attack failing if used immediately after taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual artifacts with the water ripples in the very first pond.[/p][/*][*][p]Respawning is now disabled during cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]The pause menu can no longer be opened during loading screens.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the offset of the position of the circle under the feet
[*] Fixed the standard size of the circle under the feet
[*] The circle under the feet now appears at a height of 2m and higher
[*] Fixed the inability to return to the rest area
[*] Added a 0.5s jump buffer during an attack, now the character will be more agile and will automatically jump after completing the attack if the jump was pressed
[*] Fixed a game crash after the cut scene with raising the sword
[*] Fixed some places with getting stuck
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the boss death animation was missing
[/list]

Thanks for your support!
